public_health_question.v: What were the source, characteristics and control actions of a norovirus outbreak linked to oysters harvested from Galveston Bay, Texas, in late 2022?

ev.q: Outbreak of Norovirus Illness Caused by Consumption of Oysters Harvested from Galveston Bay, Texas — November–December 2022
PHR 6/5S in southeast Texas reported 50 outbreak-associated norovirus cases from six counties.
An outbreak-associated case was defined as the onset of diarrhea, nausea, or vomiting within 72 hours after consumption of oysters harvested from TX 1
notified by Galveston County Health District of 10 consumer complaints of illness after consumption of raw (nine complaints) and smoked (one) oysters
